Method of Attack: The attackers stole source code for the League of Legends, Teamfight Tactics, and a legacy anti-cheat platform.
Ransom demand of $10 million to not leak stolen source code and delete it from servers.
Attack Vector: Security breach of Riot Games' development environment
Indicators of Compromise: Stolen source code including anti-cheat source code, entire game code for League of Legends and its tools, and Packman usermode anti-cheat
